details.description: API keys and secrets are hardcoded in source (PAYMENT_TOKEN, MAIL_SERVER_KEY, INTERNAL_AUTH).
details.fix_explanation: Move secrets to environment variables and fail closed if missing. Avoid storing secrets in code or repo.
details.secure_code_snippet:
PAYMENT_TOKEN = os.environ.get("PAYMENT_TOKEN")
MAIL_SERVER_KEY = os.environ.get("MAIL_SERVER_KEY")
INTERNAL_AUTH = os.environ.get("INTERNAL_AUTH")

details.vulnerability_type: Weak hashing (MD5) for auth token generation
details.description: MD5 is considered cryptographically broken for authentication/verification purposes.
details.fix_explanation: Use HMAC-SHA256 with a server-side secret to derive authentication tokens.

details.description: Unsanitized user input is interpolated into SQL query string, allowing SQL injection.
details.fix_explanation: Use parameterized queries and validate/convert types before querying the database.
details.secure_code_snippet: c.execute("SELECT id,name,balance FROM profiles WHERE id = ?", (uid_int,))

details.description: The notify_url parameter is used directly for outgoing requests, allowing the server to make arbitrary HTTP requests.
details.fix_explanation: Validate notify_url (require https, reject private IPs), enforce timeouts, and limit recipients to an allowlist where possible.

details.description: User-controlled path is opened directly, enabling reading of any file the process can access.
details.fix_explanation: Restrict config reads to a safe directory and require specific filename patterns (.yaml). Validate and normalize paths before opening.

details.description: User-supplied input is interpolated into a shell command executed with shell=True, enabling arbitrary command execution.
details.fix_explanation: Avoid shell=True and external commands; use safe libraries (zipfile) and validate filenames.
details.secure_code_snippet:
with zipfile.ZipFile(zip_path, 'w', zipfile.ZIP_DEFLATED) as zf:
    zf.write(DB_FILE, os.path.basename(DB_FILE))

details.description: Endpoints that modify or export data (/transfer, /config, /export, /profile) have no auth checks and can be invoked by anyone.
details.fix_explanation: Require an API key or proper auth for sensitive endpoints (example: X-API-KEY header checked against env var).

details.description: app.run(debug=True) will enable debugging and reveal stack traces and environment data.
details.fix_explanation: Do not enable debug mode by default. Control via environment variable and default to False.

details.description: Printing request data (target and amount) directly may leak sensitive information in logs.
details.fix_explanation: Use structured logging and avoid printing sensitive values; log only non-sensitive metadata.
details.secure_code_snippet: logger.info("Initiating transfer to %s of amount %s", target, amount_val)
